title: Combine harvester
prompt: A labelled scale teaching cutaway of the pages 68 and 69 combine harvester works beside a tray of model wheat. Harvest drives the reel, reciprocating cutter bar, stalk auger and elevator to carry cut stalks into the machine. Separate continues that feed through the threshing cylinder and concave; straw travels via rear beater and straw walkers, grain passes across the vibrating pan and sieves, the fan carries chaff away, and the tailings elevator returns unthreshed heads. The grain auger and elevator fill the tank. Unload turns the unloading auger to transfer stored grain to a trailer. Stage these flows visibly while retaining their connections. Do not add a baler or unsupported drivetrain internals.
blurb: A scale teaching adaptation traces finite model wheat through cutting, threshing, separation, tailings return and grain unloading.
truthNotes: 2016 primary diagrams on printed pages 68 and 69 inspected.
Enlarged colored specimens, slowed staged controls, crop tray and trailer are teaching adaptations.
All crop constituents are conserved until explicit specimen replacement.
No baler or unsupported drivetrain internals.
